claims.text: Gárulf was a rider in the Éored of Éomer, Third Marshal of the Riddermark. His Éored attacked and slaughtered the Uruk-hai of Uglúk under the eaves of Fangorn Forest, where Gárulf was killed. His horse Hasufel was given to Aragorn by Éomer when they first met in the Wold.
claims.cite: J.R.R. Tolkien, The Lord of the Rings, The Two Towers, "The Riders of Rohan"
